Breathing Exercise Guide

Guided breathing exercises (4-7-8, box, energize) with an animated pacer circle, phase labels, and cycle counter.

Ready

Cycle 0 / 4

General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. Breathe through your nose and stop if you feel dizzy.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a breathing pattern.
  2. Set how many cycles you want.
  3. Press Start and follow the animated circle.
  4. Match each phase: inhale, hold, exhale.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is 4-7-8 breathing?

Inhale 4s, hold 7s, exhale 8s. It is a popular calming pattern said to slow the heart rate and ease stress.

What is box breathing?

Equal 4-second phases: inhale, hold, exhale, hold. Used by athletes and first responders to steady focus.

Is this safe for everyone?

Sit comfortably, breathe through your nose, and stop if you feel dizzy. These are relaxation aids, not medical treatment.

How do I use the pacer?

Choose a pattern, set your cycles, press Start, and follow the expanding/contracting circle and phase labels.
